findings.title: The linked raw mechanism report retains the old training-label coordinate definition
findings.evidence: R3 scoring calls the unchanged score.py, which always writes summarize_lasher for LasHeR. The summary reads candidate_boxes_xyxy from query pair boxes and describes un-clipped candidate boxes as used by training labels. New evidence calibration instead labels query native_boxes after native clipping. The qualified report inherits the mechanism_report link without correcting that definition.
findings.impact: The candidate-recall interpretation is misleading for R3. Required diagnostic keys exist, and this mismatch does not change official PR/NPR/SR/MPR/MSR, checkpoint selection, or calibration labels. No numerical recall discrepancy is claimed without runtime data.
findings.minimal_fix: Add one scope statement to the R3 qualified report: linked raw mechanism recall describes un-clipped pair proposals, while R3 evidence quality labels use native clipped boxes. Keep the official scorer, raw report, active R2 files, and metric values unchanged.

New loader preserves threshold/pretrained checks and strict nested model-state loading; continuous video tracking is reused unchanged with first-GT-only initialization.
Full98 selection checks the split, actual 98 unique sequence records/52200 frames, six snapshots [0,1,2,5,10,20], and distinct overall versus positive-epoch selection.

The controller sends one selected positive checkpoint to all three benchmark inference phases, invokes the existing official scorer, preserves stage/training flags and baseline+2 comparisons, and records actual child exits. GPU workers are restricted to physical2/3; CPU selection/scoring hide CUDA.
